[size=150][b]Lionheart Fixt 0.19.0 - the English Shrine[/b][/size]

Act 7 is the section everyone remembers as the slog, and the numbers agree: Soldier alone is 1,496 of the
act's 2,048 spawn entries, 73% of everything in it, and the act fields 19 enemy families where the Crypt has
82. Between fights there were two conversations in eleven maps, one quest with one state, and one unique item.

The odd part is that the act's own enemies were sitting in the files unused. The shrine's enemy faction is the
Druids, the one line a rank-and-file enemy speaks is "Intruder! You won't stop us from awakening the dragon!",
and the Druid template is fielded nowhere, so every druid in the act is a generic English soldier. Three
Priestess templates are placed nowhere in the entire game - while the Druid Master, the act's boss, has the
race Priestess Super. The order she leads did not appear in its own shrine. They are all in now, 195 weighted
entries across nine maps, deepest-first, with no spawner count changed and no vanilla spawn dropped.

The Priestess line also shipped unfinished: HP 75/84/95 and AC 260/80/150 against the Priest line's tidy
80/110/150 and 230/250/280, with no damage resistance at any tier. Their spell identity was the finished half
and a good one, so that is kept and only the defences fixed. And the Druid Master shipped sharing the
rank-and-file race - HP 95, AC 150, no resistance, against an Assassin Master on her own map at HP 400 - so she
now has a boss's race of her own.

Act 7 had no merchant on any of its eleven maps, so a player who ran dry in the Stone Chamber had eight maps to
go and nothing to restock from, while Sir Roger's own acceptance line promised "my men will spread out and
clear the area". There are two Templar posts now, staffed from the act's own unplaced Knight Templar template:
a quartermaster, a field surgeon who treats knights free and charges everyone else, and a guard who finally
speaks the one dialogue tree in the act that nothing opened. The quartermaster's stock reaches back six acts -
it is gated on the same three quest checks Quinn the herbalist uses for his own reserve, so the errands you ran
in act 1 are still paying out here. And the whole post is gated on having accepted Sir Roger's help: refuse
him, and there is no camp at all.

Helping Guy Fawkes in act 1 now means something. That thread lets you renounce the Inquisition and swear to
the Queen, and it promises the Queen Mother will hear your name - and the allegiance was stored nowhere at all.
The only later act that touched the quest was act 6, which fails it in a bulk list. It is a title now, and Sir
Roger reads it: the Queen keeps druids, has kept them since before she had a throne, and his Order came to this
shrine without her leave.

The largest find was on the landing beach. Captain Isabella's generator sits inactive there, and her dialogue
tree carries a complete, voice-recorded arrival-in-England arc that nothing could reach - eleven orphaned
nodes, including a romance, a companion release-and-rejoin cycle, and combat barks. She is Grace O'Malley, the
Irish pirate, who has been posing as a Spanish captain for two years, so the woman who sails you to England is
an Irish rebel against it. Whether she is on that beach at all now depends on how act 1 ended: drive her off or
turn her in and she is gone, keep her secret and she is glad to see you, anything else and she attacks. Two of
her recorded lines had also been renamed out of reach, because voice lookup is by node id; renamed back, all 38
of her recordings are reachable and both companions' trees have zero orphan nodes.

Act 1 got the beat her romance was missing, too. Her scenes there are political throughout and the only warmth
in them was a single line, so "my blade and my heart are yours" was a long way to travel. There is a scene
after she is spared now, and answering it is what the romance requires.

Eight combat barks that had never played do now, Sir Roger's five and Grace's three. And the Inner Sanctum,
which has 88 enemies and did not contain one word, turns out to be a three-switch vault whose doors are up to
800 units from their switches - so pressing one gave no feedback whatsoever. It says what it is now, and each
stone reports what it opened.

[b]Fixt[/b] is a cumulative restoration-and-repair mod for Lionheart, after Fallout Fixt.

Download, unzip, run [i]Mod Manager.bat[/i]. Most of this is level parts, so it needs a character who has not yet
entered act 7 - and Grace's arc needs one who has not yet finished act 1's Port District. Unplayed; what you
find goes into 0.19.1.

https://github.com/EricHype/LionheartFixt/releases/tag/v0.19.0
